response.query: What simulated mixture scenarios (number of sources, recycling fractions, added Pb contributions, S/N, and low sample mass) and performance metrics (misclassification rate, true positive, ROC) will we run to benchmark the pipeline?
response.answer: We will benchmark the pipeline with simulated mixtures of 5 sources, 30% recycling fractions, 10% added Pb contributions, S/N of 30, and low sample mass of 1g. Metrics include misclassification rate, true positive, and ROC.
